title: A Pisces' playlist made the whole office cry.
old_caption:
Ever cried a little at work and felt embarrassed?
Pisces shares a playlist and the whole call feels it. It's okay to feel, even at work.

title: A Sag at 3 AM, booking a flight to avoid a feeling.
old_caption:
Ever wanted to book a trip just to outrun a feeling?
Sag closes the flight tab and calls a friend instead. Feel it here, with someone.

title: POV: a Sag wakes up in a different city.
old_caption:
Ever woken up and forgotten which city you were in?
Sagittarius checks the window: it is home. Adventure starts there too.

title: A Sag tells the truth. Too much truth.
old_caption:
Is your honesty sometimes a little too honest?
Sag gets a take two on the hat review. You can be honest and kind.

title: Dating a Sagittarius: passport required.
old_caption:
Is your idea of a date a flight to somewhere far?
Gemini plans one on the roof, and Sagittarius finds out staying is an adventure too.

title: A Sag at work: ‘what if the office was in Lisbon?’
old_caption:
37 big ideas and zero first steps? Sagittarius relates.
Pick one, then take the first small step. Big ideas, small steps.

title: A Scorpio at 3 AM: feeling 100% of everything.
old_caption:
Up at 3 AM feeling every single feeling at full volume?
Scorpio sends one honest text instead of locking it in. Let someone in.

title: POV: a Scorpio's morning. All black.
old_caption:
Six black hoodies and one secret pink sock?
Scorpio dresses dark and keeps something soft just for itself. Dress dark, love loud.

title: A Scorpio's friendship is a lifetime contract.
old_caption:
Does your best friend treat friendship like a lifetime contract?
Scorpio's runs forty feet long. Cancer and Pisces sign it anyway.

title: Dating a Scorpio: the background check is free.
old_caption:
Ever met a date who already knew everything about you?
Scorpio swaps the research for one question out loud. Just ask.
